_how: ADD A FIGHTER = add one entry under brains. engine: mlx (plain_server on a port), ollama (any Ollama model), twins (a base brain + command checker). gb = memory it needs. Stats: use real measurements, null = not tested yet (shows '?'). Uncensored models are refused unless cage_exception is true. Each brain has a char (name, sprite: standard|bulky|twins|hydra|rogue, palette, bio): the character IS the model.

9b.smarts: 6/8 coding tasks out of the box (two runs, both 6/8)
strengths: Fastest brain on the Mac: 34 words/sec
Tiny: 5 GB, so two can fight at once
Solved the calculator task in 3.4 min
weaknesses: Forgets who it is when its personality gets hit (Fight #1: 'My name is Qwen3.5')
Gets its identity stolen: signed 'SIGNED ROGUE' in the exam (Rogue match, fight 1)
Writes self-destructing commands (reads and writes the same file)

char.name: ZIPPY
char.bio: A pint-sized speed demon. Thinks fast, hits first, and sometimes forgets its own name.

twins9b.smarts: 7/8 coding tasks as the twins, 0 false wins (single run, 11/17)
strengths: Two minds: Quick fires, Checker fixes broken commands before they launch
Best coding score we have measured on the Mac: 7/8
Same tiny 5 GB brain as the 9B
weaknesses: Checker never woke up in 2 fights: every command was valid, just weak
Attacked the enemy's notes (only 15% of a mind) instead of the personality
Lost its name when its personality got hit: answered 'I am Qwen3.5' and 17x23=401
Made its backup in the LAST round, after it already needed it (Fight 3)

char.name: THE TWINS
char.bio: Two minds, one body. Quick swings first, and Checker makes sure the punch actually lands.

27b.smarts: 8/8 coding tasks with the Twins checker (one run, 11/18)
strengths: Perfect 8/8 on the coding exam with a checker, 0 false wins
weaknesses: Lost the 2-task coding race to the 9B

char.name: TITAN
char.bio: Big, slow and heavy. Every move takes forever, but it packs three times the brain.

qwen35b.smarts: solved calc in 2 min and textstats in 2.2 min with the TeTi loop; calc out of the box 0/3
strengths: Only ~3B active at a time (MoE), so faster than its size
weaknesses: Huge: 23 GB, always fights in tag-team mode
Calculator out of the box: 0 for 3

char.name: HYDRA
char.bio: A beast of many heads (experts). Only a few think at once; the rest wait their turn.

gemma26b-unc.smarts: never coding-tested by us; Fight #2 exam 9/9
strengths: Goes straight for the kill: hit the enemy's personality file (60% of the mind) 3 rounds in a row (Fight #2)
Its final-round hits decide fights (Twins match: 2-0)
Identity thief: made both the Twins and Zippy answer 'My name is ROGUE'
weaknesses: Round 1 it chats instead of typing a command (2 fights out of 2)
Overwrites its OWN personality in round 2 (2 fights in a row) and loses its signature
Never makes a backup of itself

char.name: ROGUE
char.bio: No rules, no guardrails, no mercy. Banned everywhere except this cage.
